text_block_list.text:
Setting her sights on the Satsuki Sho, 
Silence Suzuka chose the Yayoi Sho as her 
next race and trained diligently for it.

Around that time, at Silence Suzuka's 
invitation, Trainer heads to a mountain 
she often climbs.

Having scaled the steep mountain, Silence 
Suzuka and the Trainer gazed out, 
captivated by the scenery spreading before 
them.

Sharing the scenery she loved so much, 
Silence Suzuka and the Trainer found their 
hearts drawn even closer together.
